name: botler-agent
description: Lightweight personal agent framework: receives messages from Telegram / Feishu / WeChat (iLink) and autonomously completes short tasks within the data directory, with an optional in-process scheduler, a local WebUI, and health/metrics monitoring.

scripts.test: tsx --test src/scheduler/cron.test.ts src/scheduler/store.test.ts src/scheduler/history.test.ts src/logging/store.test.ts src/monitor/stats.test.ts src/greeting.test.ts src/channels/allowlist.test.ts src/channels/wechat/aes-ecb.test.ts src/channels/wechat/download.test.ts src/channels/wechat/image-batch.test.ts src/conversation/store.test.ts src/tools/clear-conversation.test.ts src/runner/decisions.test.ts
